image.subject: A quiet middle-aged man with a dark moustache in a dark suit and waistcoat, leaning on a writing desk in a book-lined study, an open book in front of him and a half-smile on his face.

storyboard.claim: The reading of Tom as a Horatio Alger hero is a tempting but flat story.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The narrator at his desk, dry half-smile, weighing a cheap moral tale.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Opens the discussion after the trial, pulling the frame back to the reading.
storyboard.addedInformation: Alger's rags-to-riches stories were popular in 1840s America.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, standing in a timber courtroom with townspeople turning to look at him, his face tight with resolve.

storyboard.claim: Tom faced his fears, told the truth and saved Muff.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom standing alone in the courtroom, townspeople watching.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Summarises the coming-of-age reading just voiced.
storyboard.addedInformation: The courtroom is the same timber room where the town convicted Muff.

image.subject: An ordinary adult in a plain grey coat sitting in a parlour armchair, reading a cheap paperback novel with a neutral, thoughtful expression, a clock on the mantel behind him.

storyboard.claim: It is tempting to read the story as a standard redemption arc.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A reader in a parlour finishing a cheap tale and nodding along.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the Alger thread: the reader is the one who wants the neat ending.
storyboard.addedInformation: Dime novels were cheap serial fiction sold to the public.

storyboard.claim: Why did Tom step forward at all?
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only question card; the shape of the question is the point.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the argument to motive.
storyboard.addedInformation: The question card frames motive as the open puzzle of the chapter.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, standing at the door of a lawyer's house at midnight, a lantern held low, his face pale and drawn.

storyboard.claim: Tom went to the lawyer in the dead of night.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom at a dark doorstep with a lantern.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the why: the conscience drove him out.
storyboard.addedInformation: The night before the trial, the lawyer's house is a dark, quiet street.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, sitting up in a narrow bed in a dim bedroom with a candle guttering on a nightstand, eyes wide open.

storyboard.claim: Anxiety, not a wish to be respectable, pushed Tom into the adult world.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom sleepless in bed by candlelight.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the pressure a body.
storyboard.addedInformation: Candlelight over a sleepless bed shows the anxiety that drives him.

storyboard.claim: He did not want to be a hero; he wanted the nightmares to stop.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only statement, banter between the two speakers.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the bed image with the emotional point.
storyboard.addedInformation: The two speakers in banter show fear, not heroism, as the real motive.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, sitting on a hard courtroom bench with his head bowed and his hands clasped tight.

storyboard.claim: Tom did not cheerfully join the system; he was crushed into compliance by his own conscience.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom on a courtroom bench, head bowed.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the agreement that he joined willingly.
storyboard.addedInformation: Tom bowed on the bench shows conscience crushing him into the system.

image.subject: A ragged, unkempt man in his forties with a grizzled beard and bloodshot eyes, wearing a torn grey shirt and stained trousers, chained at the wrist, standing before a crowded timber courtroom of townspeople on hard benches.

storyboard.claim: The town agreed Muff was guilty, and Tom used the truth to undo that agreement.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Muff chained in a packed courtroom.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from Tom's conscience to the town's verdict.
storyboard.addedInformation: Muff is the innocent man the town convicted.

image.subject: A gaunt, dark-haired man in his thirties in a torn, dirty brown coat and slouch hat, a hard face with a scar, an unshaven jaw and a cold, unblinking stare, seated among townspeople in a courtroom.

storyboard.claim: Tom used the truth to bankrupt Injun Joe's lie.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Injun Joe in the courtroom, cold stare.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names the liar whose story Tom broke.
storyboard.addedInformation: Injun Joe's cold stare in court shows the villain Tom's truth exposes.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, walking away along a dusty river road at dusk toward the wooded hills above the river.

storyboard.claim: After the trial, the trauma pushes Tom back toward childhood escapism.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom walking off down a road toward the hills.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from the courtroom to the road.
storyboard.addedInformation: The river road leads toward the limestone hills and the cave.

image.subject: A dark limestone cave with dripping stone walls closing in and a single candle's small light on the wet rock in a narrow passage.

storyboard.claim: The cave is the most claustrophobic sequence in the book.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Narrow dripping cave passage lit by one candle.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shifts from town to cave.
storyboard.addedInformation: McDougall's cave is a real limestone labyrinth in the hills above the river.

image.subject: A wooded limestone hillside above the broad brown Mississippi, a dark cave mouth among the trees, and an abandoned picnic basket on the grass.

storyboard.claim: Tom and Becky wander from a picnic and get hopelessly lost.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Picnic basket left on the grass, dark cave mouth beyond.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the cave interior to its entrance.
storyboard.addedInformation: The abandoned picnic basket shows how far from safety the two children wandered.

image.subject: A vast dark limestone labyrinth with branching passages and a faint lantern glow far away, oppressive absolute gloom filling the foreground.

storyboard.claim: The cave is a massive uncharted labyrinth of oppressive gloom.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Branching black passages, one faint light far off.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Expands the single-passage view to the whole labyrinth.
storyboard.addedInformation: Branching black passages with one far light show the maze the narration calls oppressive.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, holding his last candle aloft in a dark limestone passage, its small flame lighting his face while a girl in a pale blue dress stands behind him.

storyboard.claim: They are out of food and water, and Tom holds his last candle aloft.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom with a single candle raised; Becky behind him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the cave its human centre.
storyboard.addedInformation: Tom raising the last candle shows the boys have no food, water or light left.

image.subject: A small candle stub with a smoking wick stuck on a lump of grey clay against a dark cave wall, its flame sinking toward extinction.

storyboard.claim: The candle wick struggles and expires on a lump of clay.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Candle stub on clay, flame dying.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the candle Tom raised to its death.
storyboard.addedInformation: The dying flame on clay shows the wick running out at its lump of clay.

image.subject: A cold, black cave floor with a snuffed tallow candle and a thin wisp of smoke, absolute darkness all around.

storyboard.claim: They are left in total absolute darkness.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Nearly black frame, snuffed candle.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The candle is gone.
storyboard.addedInformation: A snuffed candle in near-black shows the total darkness the narration describes.

storyboard.claim: Tom's social tools cannot get him out of the cave.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text list of the things his charm cannot trade for.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why the cave is different from the fence.
storyboard.addedInformation: The list of trades his charm cannot make shows the limits of Tom's social currency.

storyboard.claim: Nature is totally immune to Tom's charisma and storytelling.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only statement.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the list of failed tricks.
storyboard.addedInformation: The plain statement shows that nature ignores the charisma that worked in town.

storyboard.claim: Nature is not the only danger in the cave.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only statement that sets up the threat.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets up the appearance of Injun Joe.
storyboard.addedInformation: The threat line shows a second danger the picture will name next.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, walking down a narrow side passage of a dark cave with a kite string unspooling from his hand back toward a girl sitting in a pale blue dress.

storyboard.claim: Tom leaves Becky resting and explores a side passage with his kite string.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom in a side passage, string running back to Becky.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the danger to Tom's action.
storyboard.addedInformation: The kite string running back to Becky shows Tom probing alone away from her.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, peering around a limestone corner, his candle lighting a distant hand that holds another candle.

storyboard.claim: Tom sees a human hand holding a candle and thinks it is a rescuer.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom at a corner, a second candle-hand ahead.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the hope before the reversal.
storyboard.addedInformation: The second candle-hand ahead shows a rescuer as Tom first imagines him.

left.label: HOPE
left.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, beaming and shouting with joy in a dark cave passage.

right.label: DREAD
right.subject: A gaunt, dark-haired man in his thirties in a torn, dirty brown coat and slouch hat, a hard face with a scar, an unshaven jaw and a cold, unblinking stare, turning toward the boy in a dark cave.

storyboard.claim: Tom shouts for joy, then the person turns around and is Injun Joe.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Split: the boy's joy against the outlaw's cold stare.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Pays off the rescuer hope.
storyboard.addedInformation: The split between the boy's joy and the outlaw's stare shows the reversal in one frame.

image.subject: A gaunt, dark-haired man in his thirties in a torn, dirty brown coat and slouch hat, a hard face with a scar, an unshaven jaw and a cold, unblinking stare, holding a candle close to his face in a dark cave passage.

storyboard.claim: The man is Injun Joe, the man Tom testified against, surely looking for him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Injun Joe lit by a candle in a dark passage.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Confirms the reversal.
storyboard.addedInformation: Injun Joe lit in the passage shows the killer Tom testified against, now hunting him.

image.subject: A large grey limestone boulder inside a dark cave with a cross drawn in black candle soot on its face and a stub of candle on the floor beside it.

storyboard.claim: A cross done in candle smoke marks Joe's presence in the cave.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Soot cross on a rock, candle stub beside it.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the sign of the threat's presence.
storyboard.addedInformation: The soot cross on the rock shows Joe has marked the cave as his own.

storyboard.claim: Tom is locked in a pitch black labyrinth with a starving murderer; his wit is useless.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only statement of stakes.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Summarises the threat.
storyboard.addedInformation: The stakes card shows the trapped boy facing a starving murderer.

storyboard.claim: Is the cave just a standard adventure trope?
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only question card.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces the counter-argument.
storyboard.addedInformation: The question card shows the cave may be just a cliché of adventure.

storyboard.claim: The cave may be a plot device to show he is brave.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only statement.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the objection in full.
storyboard.addedInformation: The statement shows the cave as a device to prove bravery.

storyboard.claim: The reading of a classic night and shining armor is one the speaker rejects.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only quotation of the adventure-hero phrase.
storyboard.onScreenText: A CLASSIC NIGHT AND SHINING ARMOR
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Quotes the trope being rejected.
storyboard.addedInformation: The quoted adventure phrase shows the hero-story reading the narrator rejects.

image.subject: A whitewashed picket fence on a dusty small-town street in summer, a whitewash brush leaning against it, and a dark cave mouth visible on the hill behind.

storyboard.claim: The cave is the dark mirror of the whitewashed fence.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Fence in sunlight, dark cave mouth on the hill behind.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Returns to the fence to set up the contrast.
storyboard.addedInformation: The whitewashed fence is where Tom talked his way out of work.

storyboard.claim: At the fence, talk alters reality; in the cave, talk means nothing and only physical work counts.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only statement of the contrast.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the mirror.
storyboard.addedInformation: The sunlit fence against the cave shows talk working outside and failing inside.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, cutting rude steps into a steep clay hill inside a cave with a knife, a candle stuck in the wall.

storyboard.claim: Tom cuts steps into the clay so Becky can climb.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom carving steps into clay.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the physical work the speaker described.
storyboard.addedInformation: Tom carving steps in the clay shows the physical work that finally counts.

storyboard.claim: Can he really not talk his way out of the cave?
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only question card.
storyboard.onScreenText: CAN HE TALK HIS WAY OUT?
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets up the reversal of his behaviour after survival.
storyboard.addedInformation: The question card shows doubt about whether talk can get them out.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, standing on the riverbank looking back up toward the dark cave mouth in the hills.

storyboard.claim: After escaping, Tom goes back to the cave.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom on the bank looking back at the cave.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from the escape to the return.
storyboard.addedInformation: Tom looking back at the cave shows he cannot leave it behind.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, stepping out of a cave mouth into bright sunlight among trees above the river.

storyboard.claim: He survives the harrowing near-death experience and finds an exit.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom emerging into sunlight.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the survival that precedes the return.
storyboard.addedInformation: Tom in sunlight shows the escape after the near-death ordeal.

image.subject: A heavy plank door with an iron bar and a padlock sealing the mouth of a limestone cave on a hillside above the river.

storyboard.claim: The town seals the cave door, trapping Injun Joe inside.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sealed plank door on the cave mouth.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the escape to the sealing.
storyboard.addedInformation: The door is a town decision, not Tom's.

image.subject: The dry floor of a limestone cave arranged as a hideout, with a plank table, a tin bucket, a coil of rope and a candle in a bottle.

storyboard.claim: With Joe dead and the cave safe, Tom makes the cave his robber gang's hideout.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Hideout props on a cave floor.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the sealing with the new use.
storyboard.addedInformation: The hideout props show Tom turning the cave into a gang base.

storyboard.claim: Even when faced with brutal reality, Tom's first instinct is to drag it back into play.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only statement of the thesis.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Ties back to the thesis.
storyboard.addedInformation: The statement shows Tom's instinct to turn brutal reality into play.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, and a battered straw-hatted thin barefoot boy in ragged homespun clothes, sitting grinning on a flat rock inside a cave between two tin buckets.

storyboard.claim: Tom turns the trauma into a cool clubhouse.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two boys on a rock in the cave, buckets beside them.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the play in the same place as the danger.
storyboard.addedInformation: Two boys on the rock with buckets show the trauma recast as a clubhouse.

image.subject: A freckled, sandy-haired 12-year-old boy in a faded blue cotton shirt with patched knee trousers and bare feet, grinning at the mouth of a limestone cave with a tin bucket in his hand, sunlight on the grass outside.

storyboard.claim: He immediately tries to monetize his trauma as a cool clubhouse.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tom at the cave mouth with a bucket, grinning.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets up the final turn to the buried gold.
storyboard.addedInformation: Tom grinning at the cave mouth with a bucket shows him trying to sell the trauma as fun.
